propositions: BindingStore currently embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-keying, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire) and production code mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() access, bypassing any policy seam.

Lifecycle decisions must be extracted into a private policy owner in binding_lifecycle.py operating on repository dictionaries, while the public BindingStore facade retains all existing method signatures and coordinates the policy owner and repository unit-of-work.

A narrow facade operation (note_rich_emit or equivalent) must be added for rich-text emission state mutation, preserving current counter/hash behavior and missing-binding fail-open result, to serve as the supported production mutation seam.

All existing lifecycle behaviors must be preserved identically: forward/reverse identity at-most-one invariant via targeted single-key reverse pops, three confirmed 404s trigger retirement, successful reads reset absence, immutable numeric-ID lookup re-keys, tombstoned issues suppress recreate until explicit unretire, and comment IDs remain append-only.
